headline: Walmart Says It Delivered 7 in 10 Orders Same Day or Next Day During El Fin Irresistible
summary: Walmart said it delivered seven in ten orders on the same or next day during its El Fin Irresistible sale. Video game consoles and smartphones were the top-searched products in its Mexico and Central America digital channels.
why: Walmart de Mexico is the largest retailer in Mexico, and its e-commerce delivery performance indicates competitive dynamics in Latin American retail.
original_headline: Afirma Walmart que entregó 7 de cada 10 pedidos el mismo día o al siguiente durante El Fin Irresistible
